page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines; a library stamp at lower right and a handwritten signature at the foot are not printed text.

main_text.l: Omnibus, cuiuscunque etiam conditionis, ordinis, & status, domi militiaeque, terrâ marique, vltro citroque euntibus, lectu vtilis ac verè proficuus.
Dn. FRIDERICVM iunior. Com. Palat. Rheni: &c.
Autor ex grauissimis, cum antiquis tum recentio-ribus, Historicis, Philosophis & Medicis.
Typis Ioannis Albini, Impensis Conradi Meyllii,

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the physician's name and the place of printing. Library stamp at lower right and handwritten signature "Lucae Schroeckij MD" at the foot are not transcribed. Ink on "Conradi Meyllii" partly obscured by the stamp; the reading "Meyllii" is uncertain and marked by the stamp overlap, so "Meyllii" should be checked. The line "Ad Illustrissimos..." is in italic type.
